name: The Park Tower Knightsbridge
insider_take: Sophisticated luxury meets prime Knightsbridge positioning at this distinguished Luxury Collection property, where Harvey Nichols and Harrods are practically your neighbors.
whats_special: This elegant tower hotel sits in the heart of London's most exclusive shopping district, just steps from Hyde Park Corner and Buckingham Palace. The property features stunning city views from its elevated position and offers direct access to Knightsbridge's world-famous boutiques and department stores. As part of Marriott's prestigious STARS program, guests enjoy enhanced amenities and personalized service.
pro_tip: Request a room on the higher floors facing Hyde Park for breathtaking views of the royal parkland and London skyline - particularly magical during sunset.
dont_miss: The hotel's proximity to the Wellington Arch and Apsley House (the Duke of Wellington's former residence), plus easy walking access to the Diana Memorial and Speakers' Corner in Hyde Park. The nearby Knightsbridge Underground station connects you directly to Heathrow Airport.
pros: Prime Knightsbridge location opposite Hyde Park
Elegant cylindrical tower design with panoramic city views
Marriott STARS Program elite benefits and privileges
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects exclusive London location
Busy Knightsbridge area with high foot traffic
